method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town11_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town, single modular game asset: 出生石台 (SpawnAltar). Design: Two-tier octagonal stone spawn altar with front steps, inlaid jade and gold rings with rune tiles, a lotus pedestal holding a floating jade spirit stone with halo, and four corner lanterns. Scale: Approx. 3.5 x 4.3 x 1.9 m. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (blue-grey stone paving, warm cedar timber, red lacquer, curved blue-grey tile roofs, restrained jade and gold accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, entire object visible on a light grey seamless studio background with soft contact shadow. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
